correctness.rationale: For the repaired RESULT.md: the frozen opening unconditionally asserted unequal finite-time diffusivities although a=b was admitted and gives K_1(t)=K_2(t) at every t. The repair states equality iff a=b, distinguishes the linear part of the MSD from the relaxation terms, and clarifies that the ratio has a constant limit as t tends to infinity although plugging in the limiting diffusivities gives 0/0. No coefficients or rate assumptions were changed. Independently, conditioned on the reflecting gap path, each gap jump is a tag-1 jump with probability p=a/(a+b), independently of other marks. Tag 1's increment is minus the gap increment when it jumps, and tag 2's is plus the gap increment when it jumps. Hence each tag's conditional variance is p(1−p) times the number of gap jumps, whose mean is 2q(n−1)t/n. Its conditional mean is, respectively, −p or 1−p times the net gap displacement. The stationary gap is uniform and E[(G_t−G_0)^2]=2⟨f,(I−e^{tQ})f⟩ with f(k)=k−(n+1)/2. The reflecting cosine eigenbasis and −Qf=q(1_{k=n}−1_{k=1}) give exactly the stated odd-mode coefficients and zero even overlaps. Mode m=1 exists also at L=3. The activity at time zero, strict signs at every finite time, common exponent, rate ratio, and intercept from the uniform gap variance all follow. The 90 fresh full-configuration marked uniformization comparisons covered both tags, equal/unequal rates and the triangle.
residual_risks: The independent calculation is bounded floating-point corroboration, not a proof; the exact conditional-mark and spectral calculations apply on the stipulated stationary two-particle ring.

value.rationale: For the smallest interacting finite ring system the joint time dependence, odd-mode weights, strict decay and intercept distinguish transient tagged transport from its common asymptotic diffusivity. The exact squared-rate excess ratio provides a useful check across all observation times and jump-rate contrasts, not just a trivial equal-rate check or a re-expression of the long-time diffusivity.
residual_risks: Scope is exactly two walkers with uniform stationary start; value does not rely on extrapolation to other dynamics or a many-body result.
